reason: DebUnc is an inference-time confidence controller: sampling- or prompt-derived uncertainty is communicated through prompts or token reweighting between debate rounds. References to trained base models do not make this runtime aggregation rule a trained intervention.

HiRED is open and technically valid, but its attention-guided fixed-budget token dropping adds no material method family beyond the already retained VisionTrim token-budget record. Full-text review therefore resolves it as a deliberate redundancy drop.

CoPS supplies a provable pessimism-based selector for reusing experiences only when their trial distributions match the current task. This is directly transferable to choosing prior traces under dataset or task shift.

DAS is explicitly training-free and uses tempered sequential Monte Carlo to sample from a reward-aligned target while controlling reward over-optimization and diversity loss. It is a high-value non-speech reference for Goodhart-aware reward-guided inference.

Repo2Run converts build/test feedback into a replayable Dockerfile and reports successful executable environments for 361 of 420 repositories. Retain it as an open environment-construction mechanism, with the residual failures treated as expected boundary evidence.

PaperBench provides author-approved hierarchical reproduction rubrics, executable submissions, and a separately evaluated judge. Its 21% best-agent result is useful negative evidence inside a primarily transferable reproduction-evaluation contract.

UITron-Speech is a genuine end-to-end speech-instruction GUI task. The backbone is trained on synthetic speech and mixed-modality data, while the two-step crop-and-refine grounding correction is training-free at inference. Retain it as a speech/agent experiment and decoding instrument, not a frozen-control core method.

CAFA combines ambient audio, an audiogram, conversational feedback, information-gain questioning, structured tuning commands, an ethical regulator, and an independent judge without domain-specific LLM fine-tuning. Its small English/Chinese prototype data and proprietary LLM dependency keep it at instrument rather than core status.

The benchmark isolates procedural retrieval from execution and shows that embedding methods lose temporal structure under cross-context vocabulary changes. Retain it as a test contract for retrieving executable experiment procedures.

ThetaEvolve's strongest path performs GRPO at test time and persists learned checkpoints. It is an open and useful boundary comparator, but it changes model weights and therefore cannot evidence training-free inference control.

FOREAGENT trains a pairwise execution-preference model, so it is not a training-free controller. Retain the predict-then-verify allocation pattern and calibrated preference corpus as an open transfer mechanism for reducing expensive candidate executions.

A-MapReduce provides a runtime decomposition-map-aggregation architecture for broad searches, with experiential task allocation and explicit cost/latency measurements. It is directly reusable for future survey, candidate-generation, and falsifier-search orchestration.

Chain of Mindset is explicitly training-free: a meta-agent selects a cognitive mode at each step and a bidirectional context gate controls inter-module information. This is a direct runtime routing analogue for action-policy control.

PlugMem represents propositional and prescriptive knowledge as compact memory units rather than raw traces and is attached unchanged across heterogeneous tasks. It is a strong open design for the executable research knowledge base.

One-Eval resolves evaluation intent into benchmark IDs, dataset acquisition and schema normalization, metric selection, evidence trails, human checkpoints, and rollback. It closely matches the required traceable experiment-environment interface.

RVLM runs a no-fine-tuning generate-execute loop while RRouter predicts a reasoning budget, monitors progress, and terminates stalls. Retain its open adaptive-depth and stopping mechanism; its proprietary Gemini dependency remains an implementation boundary.

AgentProp-Bench demonstrates that automatic judges can be weakly aligned with humans, separates parameter rejection from downstream recovery, and shows that a parallel interceptor helps one model but not another. Retain it as verifier and mitigation falsifier evidence.

This is a training-free analysis over frozen speech SSL backbones with open code and a direct d-prime severity measure. Local LibriSpeech is an exact corpus occurrence but supplies only healthy controls, so the dysarthria task still requires non-local clinical corpora and cross-corpus severity calibration.

MemQ propagates runtime success credit backward through the provenance DAG that links retrieved memories to derived memories. This is a direct open mechanism for reward-guided online memory and evidence provenance.

Pi-Serini shows that tuned BM25 plus sufficient retrieval depth can expose high evidence recall in an agent loop. Retain the open retrieval/browse/read baseline for the literature knowledge base while treating its frontier-model dependence as a cost boundary.

MemLens provides a multimodal memory falsifier: long-context systems degrade with length while memory agents remain length-stable but lose visual fidelity during storage-time compression. The open benchmark can test evidence-preserving memory choices.

MemSyco-Bench tests whether an agent rejects memory as evidence, limits its scope, resolves memory/evidence conflicts, tracks updates, and personalizes only when valid. Retain it primarily as negative/falsifier coverage for memory-induced sycophancy.
